task_spec.title: Dataset reconnaissance
task_spec.objective: Five files have just arrived from the data vendor: members, providers, medical claims, pharmacy claims and a medication-adherence table. Before anyone builds on them, tell us what is in each file, whether the identifiers can be trusted, what period the dates cover, whether the files join to each other the way we would expect, and anything that looks wrong. Produce the standard artifacts (data contract, missingness table, report).

component_catalogue.description: Load the task's input tables with the project dtype policy and record row and column counts.
Column names, dtypes and dtype counts per table, written as the data contract.
Null counts per column with a list of entirely empty columns per table.

scope.description: Whether to profile only the ten most-null columns per table or every column.

component_catalogue.description: Row count versus distinct count for candidate key columns, deciding whether each is a unique key.

keys.description: Which table.column keys (composite keys joined with '+') to test for uniqueness.

produces.shape: {key: {n_rows: int, n_unique: int, duplicate_rows: int, is_candidate_key: bool}}

component_catalogue.description: Minimum, maximum and unparseable count for date columns, optionally with date-order consistency checks.

columns.description: Which table.column date columns to profile.

consistency_checks.description: Whether to count medical claims whose adjudication precedes the service end or whose service end precedes its start.

component_catalogue.description: Cardinality, unmatched keys and row counts for selected cross-table key pairs.

produces.shape: {pair: {cardinality: many_to_one|one_to_one|no_match|many_to_many, rows_left: int, rows_after_inner_join: int, unmatched_left: int, unmatched_left_denominator: int, right_key_unique: bool}}

component_catalogue.description: Write report.md with summary, results, artifacts, caveats and method sections.

caveats.description: Which fixed caveat statements to include in the report's Caveats section.

show_denominators.description: Whether every rate in the report is printed as numerator / denominator = rate.

cite_artifacts.description: Whether every results bullet ends with a [source: ...] reference to an artifact or metrics key.

plan.rationale: Comprehensive dataset reconnaissance to establish trust in identifiers and relationships. Includes schema profiling for data contract, all-column missingness analysis for complete data quality visibility, candidate key validation across all dimensions, date range analysis with consistency checks (critical for adjudication sequence and temporal integrity), join validation across all relationships (essential to identify pharmacy NPI linkage gaps evident in manifest), and structured report with denominators and artifact citations for reproducibility and statistical discipline.
